info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Term Deposit Framework Agreement API
info.description: This API allows financial institutions to update terms of existing term deposit framework agreements. It facilitates modifications to interest rates, conditions, and account details to better serve clientele needs. Typical consumers of this API include banking systems and financial service providers looking to enhance customer account management functionalities. The endpoint streamlines the process of maintaining up-to-date agreements in line with regulatory compliance and customer preferences.

patch.summary: Update a term deposit framework agreement.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific term deposit framework agreement identified by its resource ID. Use this endpoint to adjust terms, rates, or any other relevant details associated with the agreement to ensure it meets your requirements.

requestBody.description: This PATCH request updates the term deposit framework agreement for the specified resource. Ensure that the payload conforms to the defined schema for successful processing.
